    StartersWilly's salmon bitesSoy, honey and ginger glazed salmon cubes, baked and served on toothpicksHow to make it600g salmon fillet, skin off3 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp honey1 tbsp grated ginger2 limes, cut into wedgesCut the salmon into bite-sized cubes. Mix the soy sauce, honey and ginger and toss the salmon through.Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200°C until just cooked and sticky.Spear on toothpicks and serve with lime wedges.Glen and Annie's grilled cheese soldiersGolden grilled cheddar sandwiches cut in fingers, tomato sauce to dipHow to make it8 slices of white bread40g butter, soft8 slices of cheddar3 tbsp tomato sauce, for dippingButter the bread on the outside and sandwich with the cheddar.Cook in a pan over medium heat until golden and melted on both sides.Cut each sandwich into 4 fingers and serve warm with tomato sauce.Oregon coast clam chowder cupsThe Pacific Northwest coastlineHow to make itAs written, serves 4Creamy clam chowder with bacon, potato, onion and thyme, ladled into small cups and topped with crumbled bacon, chives and oyster crackers.Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp and set half aside.Soften an onion and 2 celery sticks in the fat, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then add 2 cans baby clams with their juice, 400ml milk, 2 diced potatoes and thyme.Simmer 15 minutes until the potato is tender.Stir in 150ml cream and heat through without boiling.Ladle into cups and top with bacon, chives and oyster crackers.Grilled corn with butter and paprikaJesse's harmonica, Willy's favourite song.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRandolph's chilli crab linguineLinguine with crab, garlic, chilli and lemon, topped with toasted breadcrumbsHow to make it400g linguine40g breadcrumbs80ml extra virgin olive oil, plus a little extra3 garlic cloves, sliced1/2 red chilli, seeded and sliced300g crab meat1 lemon, zested and juiced1 tbsp chopped parsleyCook the linguine in well salted water.Toast the breadcrumbs in a little oil until golden. Set aside.Gently fry the garlic and chilli in the oil for 2 minutes.Add the crab, lemon zest and juice and a ladle of pasta water and warm through.Toss with the drained pasta and parsley, then scatter with the crumbs.Jesse's park kiosk chilli cheese dogsFranks in toasted rolls under beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar and spring onionHow to make it8 beef frankfurts8 hot dog rolls500g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin400g tinned crushed tomatoes400g tinned kidney beans, drained150g cheddar, grated1 tbsp vegetable oil1 bunch spring onionsFry the onion and garlic in the oil until soft.Add the mince, chilli powder and cumin and brown well.Add the tomatoes and kidney beans and simmer until thick.Simmer the franks in water for 5 minutes and toast the split rolls.Put a frank in each roll, spoon over the chilli, top with cheddar and grill a minute to melt. Scatter with sliced spring onion.SweetsOrca cookies and creamVanilla ice cream with crushed chocolate cookies and white chocolate finsHow to make it1 L vanilla ice cream150g chocolate cream biscuits, crushed100g white chocolateSoften the ice cream slightly and fold through the crushed biscuits. Freeze for 2 hours.Melt the white chocolate, pipe little fin shapes onto baking paper and set in the fridge.Scoop the ice cream into bowls and stand a fin on top.DrinksBlue lemonade ice cream floatLemonade tinted blue with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on topHow to make it1 L cold lemonade1 tsp blue food colouring4 scoops of vanilla ice creamPour the lemonade into tall glasses and add a drop or two of blue colouring to each, stirring until ocean blue.Gently add a scoop of ice cream so it floats and foams. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw.Marionberry lemonadeFor the night drive to the cove.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
